chain_words.nuance: expecting that good things may happen
believing that things will turn out well
calm and certain in how you present yourself
completely sure that something is true

explanation: These words all express a positive belief about the future or about yourself, moving from a gentle expectation to complete certainty.

usage_notes.difference: 'Confident' describes your belief in your own ability; 'certain' describes being sure that a fact or outcome is true.
